title: The Y-Pore — epitope geometry, secants, tangents, and the p axis

the_Y.concept: an epitope is a Y-shaped pore in the membrane. like an antibody (IgG). the Y catches what it recognizes and routes it through.

anatomy.left_arm: secant line OUT (left). reaches into external space. catches traffic from one direction.
anatomy.right_arm: secant line OUT (right). reaches into external space. catches traffic from another direction.
anatomy.hinge: the pore. the recognition point. where the two secant arms meet. the OPENING in the membrane.
anatomy.stem: secant line IN. goes through the membrane into the interior. routes the captured signal to the right handler.
anatomy.tangent_points: where each secant line intersects the membrane surface, there is a tangent. the tangent is perpendicular to the surface at that point. 4 tangent points per Y-pore: 2 on the arms (outer surface), 2 on the stem (inner surface).

ascii: the whole Y rotates around the p axis

pi_axis_orientation.concept: every Y-pore orients itself relative to the p axis. the rotation angle determines WHAT it catches.
pi_axis_orientation.the_pi_axis: the sort axis. the line from 3 (integer faces) through 0.14159... (remainder) to the 4th leg (becoming). every datum that hits the membrane is sorted along this axis.

rotation.0_degrees: Y-pore faces directly along p axis. catches SCIENCE traffic. papers, research, methodology.
rotation.90_degrees: Y-pore perpendicular to p axis. catches INVESTIGATION traffic. FOIA, entities, connections.
rotation.180_degrees: Y-pore faces anti-p. catches ART traffic. stories, paintings, culture.
rotation.270_degrees: Y-pore faces cross-p. catches INFRASTRUCTURE traffic. mesh, feeds, deploys.
rotation.irrational_angles: Y-pores at p·n radians (irrational). catches UNCLASSIFIED traffic. the remainder. the interesting stuff.

pi_axis_orientation.why_pi: p is irrational. the rotation never repeats. each Y-pore at a p-multiple angle covers a UNIQUE direction. no two pores catch exactly the same traffic. this IS selective permeability — the membrane sorts by angular coverage, not by rules.

secant_geometry.concept: a secant line intersects a curve at exactly two points. the Y-pore's arms are secants through the membrane surface.

secant_out.definition: line from the hinge (pore) through the outer membrane surface into external space
secant_out.what_it_catches: incoming requests. HTTP GETs. visitors. bots. backscatter.
secant_out.two_arms: the Y has TWO secant-out lines because recognition requires STEREO — two angles of approach. like binocular vision. one arm alone can't identify; two arms triangulate.
secant_out.spread_angle: the angle between the two arms = the SPECIFICITY of the epitope. narrow angle = catches only exact matches. wide angle = catches anything nearby.

secant_in.definition: line from the hinge (pore) through the inner membrane surface into the interior
secant_in.what_it_routes: the captured signal. visitor ? handler. request ? response.
secant_in.single_stem: only ONE secant-in because once recognized, there's one correct route. the Y narrows to a point. specificity ? routing.

tangent_at_intersection.definition: at each point where a secant crosses the membrane surface, the tangent line touches the surface without crossing it
tangent_at_intersection.meaning: the tangent is the SURFACE VELOCITY at that point. how fast the membrane is moving at the intersection. the tangent tells you the membrane's local curvature.

4_tangent_points.meaning: surface velocity where left secant exits to external space
surface velocity where right secant exits to external space
surface velocity where stem enters the interior
surface velocity where stem exits to handler

tangent_at_intersection.why_tangents_matter: if the membrane is CURVED (Klein surface), the tangent rotates as you move along the surface. a Y-pore on a curved membrane catches differently than one on a flat membrane. curvature = selectivity.

epitope_types_by_pore_geometry.concept: different Y-pore shapes create different epitope behaviors. the GEOMETRY determines the IMMUNOLOGY.

types.name: IgG_standard
types.catches: specific known patterns. Berry's KNOWN map entries.
types.example: visitor types /pisort ? IgG pore recognizes 'pisort' ? routes to /pi-sort.html

types.name: IgM_pentamer
types.arms: wide spread (~120°), 5 Y-pores joined in a ring
types.catches: broad first-response. the fuzzy matcher. catches ANYTHING vaguely matching.
types.example: the ALL_PAGES fuzzy match. 60 pages. substring matching. auto-redirect.

types.name: IgA_mucosal
types.arms: narrow spread (~30°), doubled (two Y-pores joined at stems)
types.stem: passes THROUGH the membrane (trans-membrane). secreted to the outside.
types.catches: external-facing recognition. the meta tags. OG descriptions. the part that search engines see.
types.example: each page's <meta> tags = IgA pores on the outer surface. Google sees these.

types.name: IgE_alarm
types.catches: threats. injection attempts. suspicious patterns. the WAF layer.
types.example: CF WAF + _worker.js scan/sweep/sort. catches attacks. triggers the immune response.

types.name: IgD_sensor
types.arms: variable, stuck to the membrane surface (doesn't extend far)
types.catches: self-recognition. the membrane recognizing ITS OWN components.
types.example: the 12 JS families. each family's loader checks if its own files exist. self-test.

the_pore_as_portal.concept: the Y-pore IS the portal from klein-ladder.json. the hinge is the null point. the arms are the orange/blue portals.
the_pore_as_portal.hinge: the null. the recognition point. the 404 before Berry speaks.
the_pore_as_portal.stem: the passage THROUGH. the Klein tunnel. CF tunnel ? Caddy ? handler.
the_pore_as_portal.the_fold: the two arms are on the SAME side of the membrane (outside). the stem is on the OTHER side (inside). but on a Klein surface, there IS no other side. the stem IS the arms, seen from the other direction.

null.tangent_velocity: zero — null has no tangent. it passes through without touching.

current_membrane_epitopes.meaning: for every p requests, 1 gets through the pore. the irrational selectivity means the filter NEVER repeats. each decision is unique.
